answer.short:
$x=14.47\,\mathrm{cm}$.

Use the perpendicular height of $12\,\mathrm{cm}$ and the sine ratio.
answer.worked:
Draw a perpendicular from the upper-left vertex to the bottom side. Its length is $12\,\mathrm{cm}$ because the top and bottom sides are parallel.
$$\begin{align*}\sin56^\circ&=\frac{12}{x}\\x\sin56^\circ&=12\\x&=\frac{12}{\sin56^\circ}\\x&\approx14.47\,\mathrm{cm}\end{align*}$$
